title: Regulating the metal-insulator transition of REBaCo2O5+δ combining RE-substitution and anion control
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,16954-16962
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00137H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Fang Zhang, Yuchen Cui, Jingxin Gao, Hao Zhang, Yi Bian, Chen Liu, Nuofu Chen, Jikun Chen
Enabling abrupt MITs for REBaCo2O5+δ relies on the synergistic coordination between the RE ionic radius-induced CoO6 octahedral distortion and the oxygen vacancy-modulated Co valence state to reach a low structural symmetry, with δ approaching 0.5.
